title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-gem-13b v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Onboard aurora-gem-13b v1.0 into the model registry with curated metadata, performance profiles for common seq lengths, and automated changelog generation so releases surface in release notes and the model catalog. Motivation: aurora-gem has strong quality on our chat evals and previous ad-hoc entries lacked standardized perf profiles and changelog entries. This PR adds: 1) model metadata (name, architecture, parameter_count, tokenizer, default max_seq, recommended context bucket profiles), 2) performance profiles for 8/32/2048 token patterns measured on A100-80GB and RTX6000 with quantized and fp16 variants, 3) automated changelog entry templates and CI job that validates changelog formatting and auto-inserts release notes on merge, 4) small docs update and example inference call in registry examples. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and docs - [x] Include perf profile CSVs and normalized throughput/latency rows - [x] Hook changelog automation workflow (changelog-lint + generate-release-note) - [x] Add unit tests for metadata schema validation - [x] Have at least two reviewers approve - [x] CI green (lint/build/tests) Implementation notes: metadata files are placed under models/aurora-gem/metadata.json and perf profiles under models/aurora-gem/perf/*.csv. The changelog automation is implemented as a new GitHub Actions job .github/workflows/changelog-generator.yml which runs on push to main when PR merges and validates that model metadata contains required keys (model_name, version, family, backend_support) before creating a release note draft. The job reuses existing changelog lint action and a small node script scripts/generate_changelog.js to produce the markdown fragment. Backwards compatibility: existing registry consumers only read model metadata and perf profiles; added fields are optional but recommended. Related: ENG-3124 (onboarding cadence), PM-144 (catalog release), SUP-788 (support ticket requesting perf numbers for SLA planning).

release_notes: Added aurora-gem-13b v1.0 to the model catalog with curated performance profiles (A100/RTX numbers) and automated changelog generation on merge. Perf profiles include recommended context buckets and quantization guidance. See docs/model-catalog/aurora-gem.md for details.
notes_for_qa: QA: validate metadata.json schema by running tests/test_metadata_schema.js, verify perf CSVs parse and that throughput/latency numbers fall within expected ranges, and ensure changelog artifact is produced by the workflow on merge.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: incorrect perf numbers could mislead capacity planning. Mitigation: perf CSVs include raw measurement IDs and seed; we added a step in workflow to reject profiles missing backend or quant columns and unit tests that assert numeric columns are present.
